# Kth Largest Element in a Stream
# Idea: To find the kth largest element in a stream of integers, we can use a min-heap (priority queue) with a maximum size of k. As new elements arrive, we add them to the min-heap. If the size of the heap exceeds k, we remove …
# Line comments below keep the same logic as the NeetCode 150 repo solution.

import heapq


class KthLargest:
    def __init__(self, k: int, nums: List[int]):
        self.min_heap = []
        self.k = k

        for num in nums:
            self.add(num)

    def add(self, val: int) -> int:
        # Heap ops keep min/max ready
        heapq.heappush(self.min_heap, val)

        if len(self.min_heap) > self.k:
            heapq.heappop(self.min_heap)

        return self.min_heap[0]


# Your KthLargest object will be instantiated and called as such:
